svg.title: content program
svg.desc: A leaf in two halves, one solid and one cut by two veins, cut from a purple-600 tile. Drawn on the drawn-mark box and rules (docs/favicons/README.md): solid fills, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16. Chosen 2026-11-07, the owner's first favorite: redrawn after the bold leaf of the Solar icon set (480 Design, CC BY 4.0), with two veins where it has three, since three at the 2.5-unit gap leave veins too thin to see; the ideas it was chosen from are in docs/prototypes/program-mark-ideas.html.
